design.windows: Same 47 complete rolling windows, USD1000 owned ETH initial equity, unchanged signals and costs.
design.control: For each window, initial passive BTC/ETH/cash weights equal the strategies mean realized end-of-day marked asset weights. Rebalance once at next daily open using prior close quantities and existing cost/minimum rules; then hold quantities. Cash no interest, no final liquidation.
design.limitation: Weights use future window information: ex-post composition diagnostic, not tradable control, exact exposure matching, risk matching or causal proof. Control weights drift; report realized means. Full strategy-control attribution remains unresolved.
design.count: 141 diagnostic controls + 423 stress scenarios = 564 new evaluations; reuse baseline141 ledgers. Three signal hypotheses unchanged.
design.protection: No parameter tuning, winner promotion, holdout, confidence claims or multiple-testing independence assumed.
